answer: Gate standing behind a sequential beacon puzzle no farm can parallelize. Each epoch the network publishes a beacon value, and an identity earns its voice only by computing a verifiable delay chain seeded from it: wall-clock time, impossible to split across machines. A Sybil operator with a thousand clones must run a thousand chains one step at a time, so a fake fleet costs hours, not keys. The pigment of honest standing deepens only as chains complete, like saffron harvested one thread at a time, never in bulk, so cheap identities cannot ripen before the epoch closes.
